title: Corporate Code of Conduct and Compliance Handbook
description: Annual compliance document covering ethical behavior, anti-bribery regulations, and whistleblower protections.

segments.title: Equal Opportunity & Anti-Harassment Policy
segments.summary: Mandates a respectful work environment prohibiting harassment, discrimination, or retaliation based on gender, race, or religion.
segments.transcript: Chapter 1: Workplace Respect. Our company is committed to maintaining a diverse, safe, and inclusive work culture. All employees are strictly entitled to work free from harassment...
possible_questions: What is the company policy on workplace harassment?
How does the company handle discriminatory complaints?

segments.title: Gift and Entertainment Policy
segments.summary: Sets monetary gift limits ($50 max) and reporting procedures to avoid conflicts of interest with vendors and clients.
segments.transcript: Chapter 2: Conflicts of Interest and Gifts. Employees may not accept gifts, hospitality, or entertainment valued above $50 from existing or prospective business partners...
possible_questions: Can I accept a gift from a vendor or client?
What is the maximum allowed gift value before reporting?

segments.title: Whistleblower Protection and Reporting Channels
segments.summary: Explains confidential reporting channels, anonymous hotlines, and non-retaliation guarantees for whistleblowers.
segments.transcript: Chapter 3: Speaking Up. If you suspect unethical or illegal behavior, you are protected under our non-retaliation policy. Reports can be submitted 24/7 anonymously...
possible_questions: How can I report a compliance violation anonymously?
Am I protected from retaliation if I report misconduct?
